rationale: Inflation at 3.6% is 1.6pp above 2% target with positive output gap +0.34. Real rate ~0.4% is below 1% neutral, so stance is still accommodative. Taylor benchmark is 4.75%. statement: Inflation remains well below target with slack in the economy; we are cutting the policy rate to 0.75% to support a return to full employment and 2% inflation.
rationale: Inflation at 0.84% is ~1.2pp below 2% target and output gap at -0.74% remains negative, though improving from -1.43%. Real rate ~0.2% is already accommodative vs 1% neutral, driving the +0.7pp gap improvement, but persistent disinflation (0.92% to 0.84%) shows more support needed for medium-term return to target. Markets are orderly (0.22% drawdown, vol down, +228bps return) with no stability constraint, so a 25bp insurance cut to 0.75% adds stimulus to close remaining slack and lift inflation, while remaining gradual given strong gap momentum.

rationale: Inflation at 1.0% remains below 2% but ticked up as output gap closed from -0.74 to -0.01. Policy remains accommodative: real rate ~0% vs 1% neutral, so still supports recovery. Markets stable with no halts/margin calls, so 25bp hike (-~100bps stocks) is safe.
